title: Neotoma security and migration — live status
subtitle: The standing tracker for security and client-instance migration work on Neotoma: advisories, code fixes, detection controls, enforcement gaps, migration prerequisites, and operator actions. Status is resolved from GitHub at render time rather than maintained by hand.
scope_note: Scope: this page is not limited to a single incident. It began with the work surfaced by the August 2026 findings, now also carries the client-instance migration that work prompted, and is where both are tracked from here, so later findings join this list rather than starting a new one.

groups.name: Advisories (private disclosure)
groups.note: Vulnerabilities requiring a private GitHub Security Advisory before any public detail. Not GitHub issues by design.

groups.name: Client-instance migration
groups.note: Prerequisites for moving the hosted client instance into the client's own infrastructure. Tracked here because the migration was prompted by the security findings and shares their gates: a patched release, an owner that is not the nil UUID, a tested restore, and a log drain before any data is written.
